skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe knowledge about information, data processing, information systems, electronic computers, hardware, software, organization of electronic computers, solving problems with computers.
Explain and apply methods of data representation in electronic computers, describe components of computer systems.
Perform operations in Windows operating system and use common office applications like Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
Understand basic concepts in Python, data types, operators, expressions, input/output operations, programming structures in Python, and apply them to build simple programs.
Efficiently solve problems related to data representation, electronic computers, basic software, and Python programming.
Collaborate effectively to complete group tasks within specified timeframes.
Proficiently use office applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and basic programming with Python.
Independently complete assignments and projects assigned by instructors.
Participate in discussions, defend personal opinions, and contribute to group problem-solving.
